rules.name: recon-snapshot-trade-id-suffix-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT p.proname, position('trade_id || ''-'' || v_bu' IN p.prosrc) > 0 AS appends_bu_suffix FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND p.proname IN ('recon_postprocess_settle', 'recon_postprocess_actual') ORDER BY p.proname

SELECT 'snapshot' AS side, trade_id::text AS trade_id FROM (SELECT trade_id FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu AND settlement_date = :settlementDate LIMIT 3) a UNION ALL SELECT 'cloned_deal_ticket', trade_id::text FROM (SELECT trade_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu LIMIT 3) b

WITH s AS ( SELECT DISTINCT trade_id::text AS trade_id FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu AND settlement_date = :settlementDate ) SELECT count(*) AS snapshot_trades, count(*) FILTER (WHERE trade_id LIKE '%-' || CAST(:bu AS text)) AS with_bu_suffix, count(*) FILTER (WHERE trade_id NOT LIKE '%-' || CAST(:bu AS text)) AS without_suffix FROM s

WITH s AS ( SELECT DISTINCT trade_id::text AS raw_id, CASE WHEN trade_id::text LIKE '%-' || CAST(:bu AS text) THEN left(trade_id::text, length(trade_id::text) - length(CAST(:bu AS text)) - 1) ELSE trade_id::text END AS stripped_id FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu AND settlement_date = :settlementDate ), c AS ( SELECT DISTINCT trade_id::text AS trade_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS snapshot_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c ON c.trade_id = s.raw_id) AS found_raw, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c ON c.trade_id = s.stripped_id) AS found_after_strip, (SELECT count(*) FROM s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c WHERE c.trade_id = s.stripped_id)) AS missing_after_strip, (SELECT count(*) FROM c) AS cloned_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s WHERE s.stripped_id = c.trade_id)) AS cloned_not_in_snapshot

expect.reason: both recon_postprocess_settle and recon_postprocess_actual must exist in the opera schema
the deployed postprocess functions append the BU suffix to trade_id, this is the cause of the raw mismatch
once the BU suffix is stripped every snapshot trade exists in cloned_deal_ticket_table: no deal is missing
the stripped join must match at least one trade
